title: S.I. No. 12 of 2026 - Tourism Development (CP Touring) Order
text:
97
Tourism Development (CP Touring) Order
SAINT LUCIA
STATUTORY INSTRUMENT, 2026, No. 12
[ 9th February, 2026 ]
In exercise of the power conferred under section 81(a), 83(1)and
86(1)(a) of the Tourism Development Act, No. 1 of 2024, the Minister
responsible for tourism makes this Order:
Citation
1.This Order may be cited as the Tourism Development (CP
Touring) Order, 2026.
Approved tourism investment
2. The replacement of a vehicle by CP Touring is declared an
approved tourism investment.
Declared benefits with regard to import duty and excise tax
3.—(1) Subject to subsections (2) and (3), the declared benefits
for the approved tourism investment with regard to import duty and
excise tax are —
(a) a one hundred per cent waiver of import duty on one new
2024 Nissan X-Trail 1.5HA EEXC SUV ELE AT;
(b) a one hundred per cent waiver of excise tax on one new
2024 Nissan X-Trail 1.5HA EEXC SUV ELE AT.
(2) The declared benefits under subsection (1) are applicable for
a period of one year commencing from the 20th day of May, 2025 and
terminating on the 19th day of May, 2026.
(3) The declared benefits under subsection (1) are subject to the
conditions that —
(a) the 2024 Nissan X-Trail 1.5HA EEXC SUV ELE AT—
(i) is used for tourism transportation,
(ii) is insured at market value,

98
Tourism Development (CP Touring) Order
(iii) complies with the licensing requirements of the
Licensing Authority of the Ministry of Transport;
(b) the management of CP Touring —
(i) submits to the Ministry of Tourism a report within
thirty days of procurement of the 2024 Nissan
X-Trail 1.5HA EEXC SUV ELE AT,
(ii) submits data to the Ministry of Tourism and the
Department of Statistics to assess the impact on
the tourism sector and for monitoring and
compiling the Tourism Satellite Account,
(iii) does not sell the 2024 Nissan X-Trail 1.5HA
EEXC SUV ELE AT for use in the tourism
transportation sector, except where the 2024
Nissan X-Trail 1.5HA EEXC SUV ELE AT
meets the standards for tourism transportation,
within five years of the date of clearance by the
Customs and Excise Department,
(iv) pays the applicable duties if the 2024 Nissan
X-Trail 1.5HA EEXC SUV ELE AT is —
(A) sold within five years from the date of
clearance by the Customs and Excise
Department;
(B) sold or used for any other purpose without
the approval of the Ministry of Tourism and
the Ministry of Transport,
(v) retains the exemption of the import duty and
excise tax, if the 2024 Nissan X-Trail 1.5HA
EEXC SUV ELE AT is disposed for unforeseen
circumstances, and
(vi) complies with the —
(A) reporting requirements of the Ministry of
Tourism and the Department of Statistics;
(B) Saint Lucia National Standard - SLNS74:2016
Ground Tourism Transportation and Motor
Vehicles and Road Traffic Act, Cap. 8.01;

99
Tourism Development (CP Touring) Order
(C) monitoring, licensing and certification
requirements of the Ministry of Tourism and
any other agency of the Government.
Made this 3rd day of February, 2026.
ERNEST HILAIRE,
Minister responsible for tourism.
SAINT LUCIA
